hooks.command: sh -c 'if [ -x ./.agents/hooks/guard-base-branch.sh ]; then exec ./.agents/hooks/guard-base-branch.sh "\$@"; elif [ -x ./hooks/guard-base-branch.sh ]; then exec ./hooks/guard-base-branch.sh "\$@"; fi' --

Stop.command: sh -c 'if [ -x ./.agents/hooks/stop-bell.sh ]; then exec ./.agents/hooks/stop-bell.sh "\$@"; elif [ -x ./hooks/stop-bell.sh ]; then exec ./hooks/stop-bell.sh "\$@"; fi' --
